subject: SI OnRamp Voucher Reallocation + Security Attestation Needed
messages:
From: Samuel O'Neal <samuel@blueridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Park <cpark@solarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reallocate OnRamp voucher from PartnerPilot -> Solara PoC

Hi Jasmine,

Quick ask — Solara Health (contact CC'd) just confirmed an accelerated PoC schedule and we need to move the $12k OnRamp voucher currently reserved for a PartnerPilot into a dedicated Solara PoC bucket.

Background: Blue Ridge sourced the voucher as part of our SI onboarding; Solara's compliance review is nearly done but they require voucher-backed billing separation and a vendor security attestation before we sign the SOW.

Can Redwood reissue the OnRamp voucher under Solara's account and keep it constrained to that PoC? We can provide a short attestation packet today.

Attachments: onramp_voucher_details.pdf

Thanks — Sam
Samuel O'Neal
Head of Partnerships, Blue Ridge Systems
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel O'Neal <samuel@blueridge.com>, Claire Park <cpark@solarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reallocate OnRamp voucher from PartnerPilot -> Solara PoC

Thanks Sam — looping Rishi and Priyom to confirm process.

Key constraints from our end:
- We need vendor security attestation (SOC2 subsection or equivalent) before reassigning voucher to a customer account.
- Voucher must be tied to the Solara account and expire 90 days after activation.
- If Solara requests invoice-level separation, Legal needs a quick note; that will add ~2 business days.

Sam — can Blue Ridge upload the attestation and a short note confirming the usage boundary? If yes, Priyom can start the reallocation flow.

Next steps:
1) Blue Ridge uploads attestation + signed partner addendum (if available)
2) Priyom / Finance run the reallocation in the voucher system
3) Rishi approves any SLA/term exceptions for this one-off

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel O'Neal <samuel@blueridge.com>, Claire Park <cpark@solarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reallocate OnRamp voucher from PartnerPilot -> Solara PoC

Jasmine — ok to proceed conditionally.

Approvals: I approve reallocation up to $12k for Solara's PoC provided we receive the attestation and a partner-signed addendum limiting usage to PoC/test environments. Finance will flag any requests to convert promotional credits to refundable invoice items.

Priyom — please prepare a voucher reissue template and confirm the activation/expiry window (90 days). Also, put a note on the deal (RDW-4782) that the voucher was partner-sourced and requires attestation in the file.

Sam / Claire — ideally we get the attestation PDFs and a brief signed note from Blue Ridge today. If you prefer, I can send a DocuSign envelope to make the addendum official.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Samuel O'Neal <samuel@blueridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Park <cpark@solarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reallocate OnRamp voucher from PartnerPilot -> Solara PoC

Thanks — attaching the attestation (SOC2 Subsection A) and a 1‑page signed partner addendum that limits voucher to Solara's PoC and confirms billing separation.

Attachments: soc2_subsection_A.pdf; blueridge_partner_addendum_signed.pdf

We are happy to do DocuSign if Redwood prefers; the signed PDF should suffice to unblock the allocation. Please confirm when you trigger the voucher so Claire can proceed with environment provisioning.

Sam
Samuel O'Neal
Head of Partnerships, Blue Ridge Systems
